articles.title: KHPS Earns Accredidation in its First Year
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: hat a truly remarkable and historic week it has been for our Kingdom Heights family! This week has been filled with celebrations, milestones, and moments that reflect God’s faithfulness and continued favor over our schoo

body.text: hat a truly remarkable and historic week it has been for our Kingdom Heights family! This week has been filled with celebrations, milestones, and moments that reflect God’s faithfulness and continued favor over our school community.
We began the week with the unforgettable celebration of our Ribbon Cutting Ceremony, marking a new and exciting chapter for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School.
During the Ribbon Cutting Ceremony, we announced a major milestone for Kingdom Heights. After an extensive evaluation process, Kingdom Heights has officially received dual accreditation from both:

items: Cognia — accrediting Kindergarten through 12th Grade
League of Christian Schools (LCS) — accrediting K2 through 12th Grade

body.text: This achievement reflects the dedication of our faculty, staff, students, and families in pursuing excellence in both academics and Christian education. Accreditation affirms that Kingdom Heights meets rigorous standards for educational quality, student achievement, leadership, and continuous improvement.

As the celebrations continued, our K4 students joyfully participated in their Bridging Ceremony as they prepare to step into Kindergarten, while our Kindergarten Graduates proudly move forward into 1st grade. We also celebrated a truly historic moment as the Inaugural Class of 2026 walked across the stage and received their diplomas, becoming the very first graduating class in school history.

Throughout every ceremony and celebration, we were reminded that each accomplishment is a reflection of God’s grace, guidance, and purpose for our students and school community. We are incredibly grateful for the families, faculty, staff, and supporters who continue to invest in the spiritual, academic, and personal growth of our students each and every day.
This week was more than a series of events, it was a celebration of growth, perseverance, faith, and the bright future ahead for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School.

articles.title: Certificate of Occupancy granted for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School to move into newly renovated space!
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: Certificate of Occupancy granted for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School to move into newly renovated space!

body.text: Dear Kingdom Heights Parents, Students, and Families,
With great joy and deep gratitude, I am honored to share some wonderful news with you today. We have officially received our Certificate of Occupancy for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School.

This is a major milestone in the life of our school and our church family. It represents months of prayer, planning, sacrifice, generosity, inspections, adjustments, and faithful perseverance. Simply put, this moment could not have come soon enough, and we are incredibly thankful to God for His favor and timing.

On behalf of our Board of Directors and our entire church community, I want to express heartfelt appreciation to every parent, student, volunteer, giver, and prayer partner who has patiently waited and faithfully invested in this vision. Your trust in us to partner with you in providing a quality, Christ-centered education means more than we can say. Your prayers carried us. Your encouragement strengthened us. Your patience gave us room to build carefully and correctly.

Kingdom Heights exists to help raise and educate students in an environment shaped by Christian truth, character, and calling. Receiving our Certificate of Occupancy is not just a regulatory step. It is a testimony to God’s provision and a strong finish to this inaugural year’s journey of faith and foundation building.

We also want you to know that this is an initial celebratory announcement. More detailed communication is coming soon. Within the next week, we will be sending additional clarity and a developing timeline with next steps and what this means operationally for students and families.

Today, we celebrate. Today, we give thanks. Today, we recognize that this accomplishment belongs to the whole community, from The Rock Family Worship Center to every Kingdom Heights family. Thank you for believing. Thank you for trusting. Thank you for standing with us.
Geaux Royals!
Pastors Scott and Britt Silcox

articles.title: Our inaugural Basketball season is underway
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: Join us for a game! For the first time, Kingdom Heights is fielding a JV Boys team, Varsity Boys team, Varsity Girls team, and a Cheer team , signaling the growth of our athletics program and our commitment to forming students through competition, teamwork, and discipline.

body.text: This season marks an exciting milestone for Kingdom Heights Preparatory School: our inaugural basketball season is officially underway .

For the first time, Kingdom Heights is fielding a JV Boys team, Varsity Boys team, Varsity Girls team, and a Cheer team , signaling the growth of our athletics program and our commitment to forming students through competition, teamwork, and discipline.

Athletics at Kingdom Heights are about more than wins and losses. They are a place where character is tested, perseverance is built, and students learn to compete with integrity. From practices to game nights, our athletes and cheerleaders are already setting a tone of effort, unity, and sportsmanship that reflects who we are as a school.

As a young program, this season represents the beginning of something strong. We are proud of our student-athletes for stepping into this opportunity with courage and commitment, and grateful for the coaches, families, and supporters who are helping lay the foundation for Kingdom Heights athletics.
We can’t wait to see how this first season unfolds—and we’re just getting started.

articles.title: Kingdom Heights achieves AISA accreditation for athletics excellence
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: We are thrilled to announce that Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is officially accredited by the Alabama Independent School Association (AISA) !

body.text: We are thrilled to announce that Kingdom Heights Preparatory School has officially received accreditation from the Alabama Independent School Association (AISA) ! This marks a significant milestone for us, especially as we prepare to open in August 2025.
Why AISA?

As a member of AISA, Kingdom Heights gains access to a wealth of resources and opportunities that will elevate both our academics and athletics. AISA’s competitive athletic programs, professional development for our coaches, and partnerships with top-tier schools across Alabama will provide our students with the best possible athletic experience.
Key Benefits of AISA Accreditation:

items: Top-tier Athletic Programs : AISA offers competitive sports opportunities, from cross-country to volleyball and football, with access to regional and state championships.
Coaching Support : Through AISA’s professional development programs, our coaches will have the tools and resources to provide exceptional training and guidance to our athletes.
Networking & Collaboration : AISA’s network of schools allows for collaboration, sharing best practices, and giving our students broader opportunities.
Commitment to Excellence : Achieving AISA accreditation in our first year underscores our commitment to building a high-quality, competitive, and character-driven athletics program.

body.text: Coach Kendrick Epps: Leading the Charge

Under the leadership of Coach Kendrick Epps , with over 25 years of experience, we are laying a strong foundation for Kingdom Heights Athletics. Coach Epps is passionate about developing young athletes who excel in both skill and character, ensuring that our program will be rooted in discipline, integrity, and sportsmanship.
This accreditation is an exciting beginning for Kingdom Heights and sets the stage for an athletics program that will help our students grow both on and off the field.
Looking Ahead

We are excited for what lies ahead and are grateful for the incredible opportunities this partnership with AISA brings. Kingdom Heights is committed to providing a world-class athletics program that empowers our students to be strong, competitive, and principled. We look forward to the impact it will have as we launch our school in August 2025.

articles.title: KHPS is now a Hillsdale College Curriculum School
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: Huntsville, Alabama— Kingdom Heights Preparatory, a leading Christian private school, is proud to announce its official status as the first K–12 Curriculum School for Hillsdale College in North Alabama, marking a transformative milestone in its mission to shape students with truth, character, and conviction.

body.text: HUNTSVILLE, AL (June 2025) – Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is proud to announce its official partnership with Hillsdale College , becoming the first K–12 Curriculum School in North Alabama and one of only three in the state of Alabama to receive this designation.

Through this partnership, Kingdom Heights will implement Hillsdale’s content-rich, classical curriculum—grounded in the liberal arts and sciences and taught through a boldly Christian worldview. Students will engage with the great books of Western civilization, American civics, and moral philosophy, while being formed in wisdom, character, and biblical truth.

We believe that education is not just about preparing students for college or careers - but developing leaders who are spiritually formed in the image of Christ,” said Dr. Rachel Ballard, Head of School at Kingdom Heights Preparatory School. “Partnering with Hillsdale College's K–12 initiative allows us to elevate our curriculum while remaining deeply rooted in our Christian identity.”

As a Hillsdale College Curriculum School, Kingdom Heights will adopt the Hillsdale K–12 Program Guide, which is a comprehensive academic framework developed over decades to restore excellence in American K–12 education. The school will continue its commitment to teacher-led instruction, moral and civic formation, and spiritual discipleship.

This partnership reinforces Kingdom Heights’ vision to provide a high-caliber education that combines classical rigor , Christian formation , and a strong moral foundation . KHPS is preparing the next generation to lead with conviction, clarity, and compassion.
For more information about Kingdom Heights or to schedule a campus tour, visit www.khroyals.com .

articles.title: Meet the Kingdom Heights Preparatory School Servant Leadership Team
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: As we prepare for our Fall 2025 launch, we are thrilled to introduce the exceptional leaders who have joined our team. These individuals bring over 155 years of combined experience in education, ministry, leadership, and student development.

body.text: At Kingdom Heights Preparatory School, our mission is to provide a bold Christian education that develops students in wisdom, character, creativity, and faith. As we prepare for our Fall 2025 launch, we are thrilled to introduce the exceptional leaders who have joined our team. These individuals bring over 155 years of combined experience in education, ministry, leadership, and student development. Their hearts for excellence and passion for Kingdom work are unmatched—and we can't wait for you to meet them!

We are excited to welcome Melinda Cargile as the Executive Assistant to our Head of School, Dr. Rachel Ballard. Melinda holds a BS in Management from the University of North Alabama and a Masters in Human Relations from the University of Oklahoma.

She brings a rich background in both HR and ministry, with experience ranging from military to private industry. Previously, she served as the Executive Assistant to the founding pastors of the Rock Family Worship Center, Pastor Rusty and Pastor Leisa Nelson. Melinda also served as part of the Accreditation Team in the College of Education at the University of Alabama in Huntsville. Her deep commitment to Kingdom service and attention to detail make her a key asset to the Kingdom Heights launch team.

With more than two decades of experience in education and school leadership, Dean Kelly Wynn joins Kingdom Heights as our Dean of Instruction and Accountability. She holds a Bachelor of Science in Early Childhood Education and a Master of Arts in Educational Leadership from the University of Alabama.

Throughout her 24-year career, Kelly has served as a teacher, a director of children’s ministry, and an elementary school principal. Most recently, she served as the principal at Alabama Virtual Academy and Eufaula City Schools - where she helped grow the student base from 60 students to over 2,600. A faithful member and deacon at The Rock Family Worship Center, Kelly brings a wealth of wisdom, academic leadership, and Kingdom focus to our school.

Pastor Cheryl Bennett joins our team as the Associate Dean of Student Support Services. A graduate of Columbia College, Pastor Cheryl began her career in Early Childhood Education before becoming an HR Manager overseeing more than 1,000 employees. She later stepped into ministry leadership roles, serving as an Executive Pastor and Connections Pastor.

Her combined experience in education, human resources, and pastoral ministry allows her to lead with both compassion and clarity. Pastor Cheryl will be instrumental in developing the culture of care and connection that Kingdom Heights is committed to cultivating for every student and family.

For more than 17 years, Director Kat Holder has faithfully served the worship and fine arts ministries at The Rock Family Worship Center. Now, she brings her creativity, experience, and Kingdom perspective to Kingdom Heights as our Fine Arts Director.

A graduate of Masters Commission in Arizona, Kat also holds a Bachelor of Arts in Worship, a Bachelor of Arts in Christian Ministry, and a Master of Arts in Worship & Leadership from Trevecca Nazarene University. She developed and led the Youth Fine Arts program at The Rock Family Worship Center, helping students consistently place in the Top 3 at national competitions. Through the years she has led and directed numerous choirs, ensembles, dramas, plays, and conference openers. She has written and released several songs and since July 2023, she has overseen the Dream Theatre, which will be a vibrant space for Kingdom Heights students to learn, grow, and shine.

We’re thrilled to introduce Coach Kendrick Epps as our Athletics Director! A graduate of Auburn University, Coach Epps brings more than 25 years of coaching experience—along with a powerful calling to lead youth through sports and discipleship.

He has served in physical education, worked with the Fellowship of Christian Athletes, and been a licensed youth minister since 2003. Coach Epps is passionate about shaping young athletes in both skill and character, and he will be foundational in launching a dynamic, Christ-centered athletics program at Kingdom Heights.
A Dream Team for a Bold Vision

These incredible leaders are more than educators—they are Kingdom builders, passionate about forming a school culture that is Christ-centered, academically excellent, and deeply relational. Together, they bring the vision of Kingdom Heights Preparatory School to life, and we are honored to walk this journey with them.
Stay tuned for more team spotlights, enrollment updates, and exciting announcements as we prepare to open our doors in Fall 2025!
We Are Actively Hiring

Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is still building our incredible launch team—and we’re hiring for a myriad of roles across academics, student life, operations, and support services. If you're passionate about Christian education and want to be part of something extraordinary, we would love to connect with you.
The best way to stay up to date on open positions is to follow Kingdom Heights Preparatory School on LinkedIn. Join us as we launch something bold for the next generation.

articles.title: Dr. Rachel Ballard Named Head of School
articles.author: Sherei Jackson
articles.summary: Dr. Rachel Ballard, PhD, appointed Head of School to lead Kingdom Heights in its inaugural year.

body.text: We are thrilled to announce that Dr. Rachel Ballard has been appointed as the inaugural Head of School. This marks a significant milestone in the journey toward the school’s grand opening in the fall of 2025.

The search for the right leader to helm Kingdom Heights was extensive and thoughtful. Led by Dr. Mark Rutland, the search committee reviewed numerous candidates from across the Southeast. In the end, a distinguished panel of educators and leaders, including the respected retired Head of School, Mr. Don Barfield, unanimously selected Dr. Ballard for her exceptional qualifications, leadership, and dedication to Christian education.

Dr. Ballard brings an impressive resume to Kingdom Heights, with experience leading prestigious schools in the Baltimore area. Her most recent role was serving as the Director of Equity and Innovation for Madison County Schools. In this position, she seamlessly integrated Kingdom values into a secular school environment—demonstrating her passion for Christian principles and her innovative approach to education.

A long-time active member of The Rock Family Worship Center, Dr. Ballard is deeply connected to the local community and the vision of Kingdom Heights. Her heart for raising up Christ-centered leaders aligns perfectly with the school’s mission of developing students academically, spiritually, and socially. With Dr. Ballard at the helm, Kingdom Heights is set to become a beacon of both academic excellence and spiritual growth in the region.

“We believe Dr. Ballard’s leadership will be transformative—not only for our students but for our entire community,” said Dr. Rutland. “Her deep commitment to living out biblical principles and her visionary approach will inspire a generation of bold followers of Christ.”

This is just the beginning of the exciting journey for Kingdom Heights Preparatory. Under Dr. Ballard’s leadership, the school is poised to make a lasting impact on students and the broader Huntsville community for years to come.
Stay tuned for more updates as we look forward to the grand opening of Kingdom Heights Preparatory!

If you’ve been looking for a dynamic, Christ-centered academic community that prioritizes advanced academics, experiential learning, and strong biblical foundations, now is the time to apply.
Special Early Bird Discount: Apply by January 6!

As a thank you to families eager to join the Kingdom Heights community, we’re offering a 5% Early Bird Discount on full tuition for those who complete their application by January 6, 2025 . This is an amazing opportunity to save while securing your child’s place at a school dedicated to both academic excellence and growth in Christ.
For full details on tuition, including multi-student discounts and other savings opportunities, check out our tuition sheet here .
Ready to Apply? Here’s How!

items: Explore Admissions : Start by visiting our admissions page to learn more about Kingdom Heights, our mission, and what makes us unique. Click here to get started .
Submit Your Application : When you’re ready to apply, simply go to our application form here and complete the process online.

body.text: Have questions? We’re here to help! Feel free to email our admissions team at admissions@khroyals.com .

Don’t miss out on this exciting opportunity to be part of the Kingdom Heights family. We can’t wait to welcome new students for the 2025-2026 school year and look forward to partnering with your family.
